title: Title keys and clean emails
prompt: HR wants to count people by job title and email everyone, but titles and emails were typed by hand. Write `solve(employees)` so it returns `employee_id`, `job_title` and `email` in one standard form.
rules: `job_title`: no spaces at the start or end, a single space between words, all lower case.
`email`: no spaces at the start or end, all lower case.
Missing values stay missing. Return one row per employee, with only these three columns, in this order.
hints: `F.trim` handles the ends, and `F.lower` the case.
`trim` leaves double spaces in the middle. `F.regexp_replace(col, r"\s+", " ")` turns any run of spaces into one.
Functions nest, so one expression can trim, collapse the spaces and lower-case a column. Build that expression for each column and name each result with `alias`.
